purpose: Construct a strict observed-error timing basis without using timing. The already frozen Ross N=1 production configuration defines a case-specific observed error target against final REF-HIGH. A dense, prospectively fixed Reference work-precision ladder is then used to find a local error bracket around that target.

epistemic_status.classification: performance-matching construction, not untouched solver-accuracy confirmation

ross_target.configuration: P2E22 final selected ROSS N=1 outer segment for every case
ross_target.target_error: E_ross_case computed against reconstructed final REF-HIGH
ross_target.target_reconstruction_rule: Re-execute only the frozen Ross N=1 configuration untimed on each case. It must remain route-valid, pass hard mass/flux/state gates, and satisfy the unscaled storage gate. No Ross control search is allowed in P2E23.

reference_work_precision_ladder.policy: same P2E21 REPRESENTATION_BOUNDED_TOTAL research convergence policy
reference_work_precision_ladder.candidate_outer_segments: every integer N from 1 through 31 inclusive
reference_work_precision_ladder.reason: A dense fixed integer ladder gives substantially finer error resolution than the prior powers-of-two ladder without adapting N after seeing results. N=32 is reserved exclusively for REF-HIGH and is not an equal-error timing candidate.
reference_work_precision_ladder.on_invalid_segment: Stop that N configuration at first invalid segment and retain it as route-invalid. Do not substitute another policy.

error_definition.scalar_error: E = maximum of the four normalized head/theta component metrics
error_definition.storage: hard conjunctive gate only: D_storage_abs <= unscaled exact-Se P2E14 storage envelope
error_definition.mass: hard conjunctive gate only: absolute typed integrated mass residual <=1e-12 cm on every accepted segment
error_definition.transfer: fixed prescribed top/bottom transfer identity is a hard consistency gate

bracket_rule.exact_match: If a valid Reference candidate has E_ref equal to E_ross within 64 machine epsilons on max(1,E_ref,E_ross), classify EXACT_MATCH and freeze that N.
bracket_rule.local_bracket: For every adjacent integer pair (N,N+1) with both candidates route-valid and passing storage/mass/transfer gates, the pair is a bracket when (E_N-E_ross)*(E_Nplus1-E_ross) <= 0 and neither candidate is the N=32 REF-HIGH endpoint.
bracket_rule.multiple_brackets: Choose the bracket minimizing abs(log(E_high/E_low)) where E_low=min(E_N,E_Nplus1) and E_high=max(...), requiring both positive. Tie-break by smaller max(N,N+1), then smaller min(N,N+1).
bracket_rule.selected_bracket_output: Freeze both actual Reference N values and their actual errors. Do not interpolate cost or timing in P2E23.
bracket_rule.non_monotonicity: Allowed and reported. The algorithm searches every adjacent pair and does not assume temporal error is globally monotonic.

unresolved_classification.REF_COARSEST_ALREADY_MORE_ACCURATE: All valid N=1..31 Reference candidates have E_ref < E_ross, so no observed-error bracket exists above the Ross target.
unresolved_classification.REF_NEVER_REACHES_ROSS_BEFORE_REF_HIGH: All valid N=1..31 Reference candidates have E_ref > E_ross; N=32 truth is deliberately not used as a timing candidate.
unresolved_classification.INVALID_GAP_PREVENTS_LOCAL_BRACKET: Valid Reference candidates exist on both error sides of E_ross but no adjacent valid pair straddles the target.
unresolved_classification.NO_VALID_REFERENCE_WORK_PRECISION_CANDID: No N=1..31 candidate passes the hard gates.
unresolved_classification.rule: Unresolved cases are retained and excluded from strict matched-error timing. They may still be described in work-precision figures.

secondary_diagnostics.closest_reference_candidate: For every case, report the valid N=1..31 candidate minimizing abs(log(E_ref/E_ross)); no cutoff is used to alter primary bracket classification.
secondary_diagnostics.threshold_matched_context: Retain the P2E22 N=1/N=1 threshold-matched controls as a separate descriptive comparison, never relabelled as strict equal-error.
secondary_diagnostics.work_counters: Report algorithm-specific vectors only; do not create a weighted composite work unit.

future_timing_boundary.future_measurements: Ross N=1 plus the frozen one Reference exact configuration or two Reference bracket configurations
future_timing_boundary.future_interpolation: If a bracket is timed, any interpolation to the Ross error target must be separately preregistered before timing. P2E23 does not choose a timing interpolation formula.
future_timing_boundary.unresolved_cases: must not contribute to a strict matched-error speedup statistic

required: scientific unresolved classifications do not fail CI

next_permitted_action: Implement and execute only the untimed 36-case Ross-target plus dense Reference work-precision/bracketing matrix. Persist exact brackets and unresolved classes. Do not time.
